SELECT d.ID AS id, d.FLOW_KEY AS workflowKey, d.NAME AS workflowName, d.CATEGORY AS description, d.DRAFT_GRAPH_JSON AS graphJson, COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(dp.VERSION) FROM AST_FLOW_DEPLOYMENT dp WHERE dp.FLOW_DEFINITION_ID = d.ID AND (dp.DELETED = 0 OR dp.DELETED IS NULL) AND (dp.ENV_CODE = d.ENV_CODE OR dp.ENV_CODE IS NULL OR d.ENV_CODE IS NULL) ), 0) AS versionNo, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AST_FLOW_DEPLOYMENT dp WHERE dp.FLOW_DEFINITION_ID = d.ID AND (dp.DELETED = 0 OR dp.DELETED IS NULL) AND (dp.ENV_CODE = d.ENV_CODE OR dp.ENV_CODE IS NULL OR d.ENV_CODE IS NULL) ) THEN '已发布' ELSE '未发布' END AS status, d.ENV_CODE AS envCode, d.DELETED AS deleted, d.CREATE_USER AS createUser, d.CREATE_TIME AS createTime, d.UPDATE_USER AS updateUser, d.UPDATE_TIME AS updateTime FROM AST_FLOW_DEFINITION d WHERE d.ID = #{id} AND (d.DELETED = 0 OR d.DELETED IS NULL)
AND d.ENV_CODE = #{envCode}
